purpose_context: This foundation mission gives downstream teams a real Next.js and Zig baseline, verified ShovelerDB consumption, shared domain primitives, collision-safe migrations, composable API and event envelopes, contract fixtures, and CI test harnesses. It deliberately excludes invoice-manager feature behavior so P1 through P4 can own their domains and proceed concurrently against frozen contracts.
purpose_tldr: Establish the runnable repository and stable shared contracts that unblock parallel Invoice Manager missions.
